title: 5-Year Treasury Note auction — the middle leg of the compressed Thanksgiving-week block
source: EST: treasury.gov Tentative Schedule of Treasury Auctions PDF (home.treasury.gov/system/files/221/Tentative-Auction-Schedule.pdf), fetched direct by plain curl 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200, 17,195 bytes) by the treasury-coupon-announcement-2026-11-19 initial research, text layer decompressed stream-by-stream and re-tokenised into 213 rows. Row reads `5-Year NOTE / Announcement Thursday, November 19, 2026 / Auction Tuesday, November 24, 2026 / Settlement Monday, November 30, 2026`, with NO trailing `R` marker — a new issue, as every 5-Year has been. Filed estimate on the two limits this lane records: a tentative schedule is tentative by construction, and this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep — the confirming primary is the 2026-11-19 announcement itself. notes: DISCOVERED during the treasury-coupon-announcement-2026-11-19 never-assessed initial research (2026-09-09) and proposed because its proposer is the announcement that sizes it. THE WEEKDAY IS A HOLIDAY DISPLACEMENT, measured against the tentative schedule's own Aug-2026-to-Jan-2027 window: the 5-Year auctions Wednesday in August and September and Tuesday in October, November and January, with the Thanksgiving block pulling the whole run forward one session (2Y Monday 11-23, 5Y Tuesday 11-24, 7Y Wednesday 11-25) exactly as it did in 2024 and 2025. SIZE EXPECTATION $70B, unchanged at every 5-Year auction since 2024-04-24 and identical in all six monthly rows sb0590 publishes (May-26 through Oct-26 all read 70) — the 5-Year sits in the INVARIANT columns of that table, because it is a new issue every month and carries no new-issue/reopening cycle to read. DEMAND BASELINE for whoever researches it, from fiscaldata auctions_query pulled this session: 5-Year bid-to-cover since 2024-05 runs mean 2.372 across 32 auctions (min 2.28, max 2.57), and 2026's nine prints run 2.28 to 2.57 — a tight, unremarkable series. The two most recent Thanksgiving-week 5-Year auctions printed 2.43 (2024-11-26) and 2.41 (2025-11-25), BOTH above that pool mean, which is one leg of the measured null this proposer's ledger records: the compressed pre-holiday block does not show demand degradation. Proposed as an estimate; symbols: [] and no house playbook is rates-keyed, so nothing here licenses an entry.
